settings.label: Cinematic dialogue camera
settings.hint: Off gives you the game's normal dialogue camera. Applies at once.

settings.label: Shot pacing
optionLabels: Calm - just a couple of angles
settings.hint: Calm: a few long shots, no cut on every line. Balanced: a natural rhythm. Lively: frequent cuts and more camera movement, but never quick back-and-forth.

settings.label: Handheld movement
settings.hint: A barely visible drift, slow push-ins and a slow move round the speaker. Off gives a locked tripod camera.

settings.label: Camera follows the speaker
settings.hint: On: the camera gently follows the speaker when they move. Off: a locked camera that only re-frames when the speaker moves far.

settings.label: Show my character while choosing
settings.hint: While you pick an answer the camera looks at your character instead of the speaker. Needs your character to be drawn (see the option above).

settings.label: Show my character in conversations
settings.hint: Your character is drawn in the shots of conversations you start in third person, with over-the-shoulder angles. (The game has no animated body when a conversation starts in first person; there your character is not shown.)
